tasks.description: Add a light/dark theme toggle control in the application's Settings page. The toggle should immediately switch the active theme. This control should be intuitive and easy to use.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user is on the Settings page, when the theme toggle is clicked, then the active theme is switched.

tasks.description: Store the user's selected theme in localStorage so the same theme is applied automatically on the user's next visit. Ensure the storage mechanism is secure and follows best practices.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user has selected a theme, when the user closes and reopens the application, then the previously selected theme is applied.

tasks.description: On the first load, when the user has no stored preference, use the prefers-color-scheme media query to choose the initial theme based on the operating system setting.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user has no stored theme preference, when the application is loaded, then the theme is set based on the operating system's preferred color scheme.

tasks.description: Ensure the active theme is applied consistently to all pages and shared components of the application. Use existing design tokens for the dark theme.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user has selected a theme, when the user navigates to any page or component, then the selected theme is applied consistently.

tasks.description: Verify that the theme preference is correctly persisted across visits and that the system preference is respected on the first load. Ensure all edge cases are covered.
acceptance_criteria: Given various user interactions and system preferences, when the application is loaded and used, then the theme is correctly applied and persisted as expected.
